agent-mesh: update an installed Mac to the version in this checkout.
  ./update.sh [--lang en|zh-CN] [--yes] [--no-pull] [--plan] [--manual] [--full-prompt] [--repo-url URL]
  --plan     show what differs and what would run, then exit; the deployment is not changed
  --no-pull  use this checkout as is; otherwise it first fetches the upstream branch and moves this branch
             forward to the newest release tag vX.Y.Z on it. When tracked files have uncommitted changes it
             lists them and, in a terminal without --yes, asks whether to continue with the checkout as it is;
             otherwise it stops and prints the command to do so
  --yes      skip the one confirmation at the start
  --manual   update the cloud side by hand: pause the routine, send Grok Bot a command block and paste its reply
  --full-prompt  use the complete routine prompt (rules rendered on this Mac) instead of the short stub; it has
             to be pasted again whenever the rules change. Run ./update.sh without it to switch back to the stub
  --lang     language of the terminal text and the routine rules; default: the recorded one, then AGENT_MESH_LANG,
             then en
  --repo-url the repository the cloud installs from (default: the public agent-mesh repository); the cloud scripts
             in this checkout must match its release tag v<VERSION>, which is checked online before anything changes
It updates this Mac first (relay, dsh plugin, Reason Network). The relay keeps the Python it already runs on,
whichever python3 runs this script; change it with ./install.sh --python <path>. The routine prompt is a short
stub that loads the rules from the cloud computer; when it changed, it shows the new one for you to paste into
the routine, and the Bot's next reply confirms it. When the cloud side changed, it sends Grok Bot an update
request from this Mac, waits for the reply (15 minutes by default), checks it and records it. After v0.8.1 or earlier
you paste the stub first; if that update then fails, it shows a complete prompt for you to paste back.
It also refreshes the filled-in reply convention in ~/.local/lib/agent-mesh/templates and the agent-mesh
command in ~/.local/bin (agent-mesh update and agent-mesh check run this checkout's scripts).
With several Bots on this Mac it covers all of them: one engine step for the relays of every Bot, each
changed routine prompt in turn, and one cloud request sent through the first Bot that can take it.
Exit: 0 done or already up to date, 1 not fully done (see the summary), 2 usage, 3 needs a terminal (nothing changed).
